kind: bounded time sampling and playback host diagnostic; no mobile/energy acceptance claim
candidate: immutable time-sampling plans identified by source_sha256

features.allocations: separate feature enables global allocator instrumentation

methodology: Identical release probe source at 16/32/48 cubed grids, two time states, midpoint sampling. Four allocator-disabled processes/version, ABBA twice; one warmup/five samples per case and separate allocation builds. Numeric outputs, schema validity and geometry are checked outside timing; output destruction excluded. Mesh cold/retained cases use all four field shapes in both point and cell data. Fixed case changes only point pressure; deformed also changes positions; dense changes every field. Player cases use a separate two-point-field scalar/vector fixture with no cell fields so both versions perform the same semantic work (baseline player cannot interpolate tensor/complex/cell fields). Candidate cold sample validates selected datasets and constructs a pair plan on every call; baseline skips that validation. Candidate retained sampling prepares outside timing and compares to the only prior public mesh sampling API. Both player constructors are outside timing. Immutable prepared plans add setup/metadata storage; this fixture is not a total aggregate-memory budget gate. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal/energy, no peak RSS/full-frame/device claim. Separate candidate preparation rows time validation, schema/mask matching, equality checks and ordinary-range interpolation certification. Input metadata is cloned before timing (numeric arrays remain shared), correctness checks and destruction occur after timing. The ordinary-range kernel anchors to the nearer endpoint; extreme/subnormal inputs use a scaled convex fallback.
